name: io.github.Servosity/acronis-mcp
title: Acronis MCP
description: The first real CLI for the Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud platform  -  every tenant, agent, and usage

environmentVariables.name: ACRONIS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from ACRONIS_DATACENTER. Set it only to point at a different host.

environmentVariables.name: ACRONIS_BEARER_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Sets ACRONIS_BEARER_AUTH for the Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: ACRONIS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client ID of the Acronis API client (Acronis console: Settings > API clients). Used with ACRONIS_CLIENT_SECRET to mint a bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: ACRONIS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with ACRONIS_CLIENT_ID. Acronis shows it once, when the API client is created.

environmentVariables.name: ACRONIS_DATACENTER
environmentVariables.description: Acronis datacenter host prefix (for example eu2-cloud or us-cloud).
